Practice

Where did the second semifinal happen?

ANSWER: It happened in Basel, Switzerland.

It happened in Basel, Switzerland.

How many countries performed on Thursday?

ANSWER: Fifteen countries performed on Thursday.

Fifteen countries performed on Thursday.

How many countries qualified for the final?

ANSWER: Ten countries qualified for the final.

Ten countries qualified for the final.

Name one country that was eliminated.

ANSWER: Australia was eliminated.

Australia was eliminated.

Why is this news important?

ANSWER: It is important because Eurovision has millions of viewers,.

and the final is now bigger and more exciting.
